_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 16: 2025-04-25 to 2025-05-13. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He argues Iran, Venezuela and Cuba are outcasts for a reason because of how they treat their people, and that they are going to Russia to make common cause.
mentions.quote: These people are outcasts for a reason. So, we see them going to Russia
mentions.falsify_match: A formal bloc forming between Russia, Iran, Venezuela and Cuba.

mentions.claim_text: Answering people who ask why the Lord has not come as he said, he tells them to watch and study out the shmita cycle, and says they are in a new time frame for these four years.
mentions.quote: Brandon, I thought you said the Lord was coming. I said, Watch the Schmita cycle
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an unmet expectation redirected to a cycle boundary.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord talked to him about the plague and the virus coming, and that it is a bubonic plague, black death serious.
mentions.quote: It's a bubanic plague like black death serious virus
mentions.falsify_match: An outbreak with plague-scale mortality.

mentions.claim_text: He says that in October 2024, standing on stage at the prayer conference, he felt the Lord say the plague could be lessened and prayed into, and that the more he prayed the more the Lord came to him about believing.
mentions.quote: No, we can we can lessen it, but we can pray into it
mentions.condition_text: the severity is explicitly stated to be reducible by prayer
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a lessened plague and no plague are indistinguishable.

mentions.claim_text: He calls prayer over the trade wars that they end, declaring tomorrow a victory day and a Mayday, with no more fear and the thing turned around.
mentions.quote: we'll pray for the trade wars again today
mentions.falsify_match: A trade war breakthrough on or about 13 May 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He says he stands by what he says without pride or arrogance, that he simply tells what he sees and prays, and that it is black and white to him.
mentions.quote: I just tell you what I see and I pray
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a statement of his own posture.

mentions.claim_text: He says the poles are shifting in the earth, that people will not know the seasons any more, that the seasons will change quickly and things will start happening quickly, and that he does not understand how.
mentions.quote: the poles, things are shifting in the earth
mentions.falsify_match: A measurable acceleration of magnetic pole drift or a breakdown of seasonal patterns.
mentions.falsify_miss: Seasons and pole drift stay within known ranges.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that they are anointed for such a time as this to be watchmen and seers, to see what is coming and warn people of danger, with a promise that they will not follow.
mentions.quote: we are anointed for such a time as this to be watchmen
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a statement of calling.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts a professional telling him and his wife they were in denial about their child's severity and needed a reality check, and his wife's answer that he may never have had a child come out of something that severe.
mentions.quote: You need a reality check
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: family testimony.

mentions.claim_text: He says roughly ten thousand people a month tell him they disagree, often by nasty email, and that he keeps going because God said to and persecution comes for the word's sake.
mentions.quote: probably 10,000 a month at least, say something that they don't agree with me
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an audience figure, though it is checkable in principle against his own inbox.

mentions.claim_text: He says bluntly that the prophetic people who told everyone Joe Biden would be removed and Trump restored, and everything spoken in 2020, gave false prophecies and missed it.
mentions.quote: everything that was spoken in 2020 was false prophecies. They miss
mentions.falsify_match: The 2020 restoration prophecies did not come to pass, which is a matter of record and which he states plainly.

mentions.claim_text: He restates the four year window as an extension of grace for a harvest of souls, says it ends in 2029, and reports the Lord beginning to talk about a 2029 window in which the tribulation begins.
mentions.quote: if that is ending in 2029 and he started talking about the 2029 window
mentions.falsify_match: The tribulation beginning around 2029.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Note this moves the boundary from 2028 to 2029.

mentions.claim_text: He describes very powerful people with no checks and balances able to act on the strength of a name and a position, hears the word accountability, and says nobody calls them on it.
mentions.quote: No accountability. I hear the word accountability
mentions.falsify_match: An accountability scandal involving unchecked officials.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, though no names are given.

mentions.claim_text: He says it becomes too hard once you catch their hand in the cookie jar, that it takes an outcry of the people saying enough is enough, and that he saw people doing it.
mentions.quote: it has to be an outcry of the people saying enough is enough
mentions.falsify_match: A mass public outcry forcing accountability after a corruption exposure.

mentions.claim_text: He says that even when he sees in a vision that Canada is going to go the way it did, he still believes and prays because that is their job, and mentions asking when Jerome Powell can be replaced.
mentions.quote: in a vision that Canada is going to go the way that it did
mentions.falsify_match: Notable: he acknowledges the Canadian election went against what he prayed for, and keeps the vision.

mentions.claim_text: He says power outages are coming and that he warned back in the summer of last year, in July, of major cyber attacks from China, and saw people in some cities without electricity for three weeks.
mentions.quote: I saw people without electricity in some cities for three weeks
mentions.falsify_match: A Chinese cyber attack blacking out American cities for around three weeks.

mentions.claim_text: He says a lot of what he saw in 2023 and 2024 is coming to pass in 2025 and that his son remarks the words are almost on top of each other now.
mentions.quote: the words are almost on top of each other, Daddy
mentions.falsify_match: The claimed 2023 and 2024 words can be located and matched to 2025 events.

mentions.claim_text: He says they need to catch up because the words are arriving faster than he can cover them, and that he needs to look from the edge of the wall and ask what is coming now.
mentions.quote: on the edge of the edge of the wall and say, God, what's coming now?
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: framing.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him they had a window, and asks whether the darkness and turbulence that was trying to come if Harris had won really has to do with politics, answering yes.
mentions.quote: if Camila Harris would have won, do you all say, does it really have to
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a counterfactual about an election that did not happen that way.

mentions.claim_text: He says the October prayers delayed things and gave a window, and points to the stock market falling every day because of the tariffs and the tariff war he says he told them was coming.
mentions.quote: the tariff war that I told you was coming
mentions.falsify_match: A prior tariff war statement in the corpus, matched to the April 2025 selloff.

mentions.claim_text: He says a man is coming who says I am the man, like a Hitler, and that he is the beginning of many who will come out in the days ahead, taking it as a sign of the last of the last days, noting the Pope has died.
mentions.quote: He is the beginning of many that will come out in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: A run of authoritarian figures claiming singular authority.

mentions.claim_text: He says nations will jump ship and go with BRICS because they want a solution to the madness, and that the solution is a one world order, a one world currency and a digital platform.
mentions.quote: The solution to the madness is a one world order, a one world currency
mentions.falsify_match: A single global currency or settlement system emerging out of BRICS.

mentions.claim_text: He describes viewers who do not have the next hundred dollars for the electric bill and will have their power cut off, and contrasts them with people who have a surplus, extending it to praying for salvation of loved ones.
mentions.quote: they're going to cut my power off
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: pastoral framing.

mentions.claim_text: He polls the audience: type one if you think the sky is falling and a 1930s crash is coming within the next year, type two if you think it all goes up and there is never a crash.
mentions.quote: 1930s is coming tomorrow within the next year. Whatever. Type two
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: he is polling the audience rather than making the call himself.

mentions.claim_text: He says a great wave of revival is coming to the Mormon churches to set the captives free, with a shifting and a splitting in which not everybody follows, and that the Lord said he would do something major there.
mentions.quote: it's going to be a great wave of revival in this Mormon churches
mentions.falsify_match: A visible schism or mass conversion movement within the LDS church.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not believe in lighting candles or those practices, only in seeking Jesus wholeheartedly and reading the Bible, and accepts that this will make some viewers angry.
mentions.quote: I just believe in seeking Jesus with all my heart
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a doctrinal position.

mentions.claim_text: He introduces a prophetic dream from 2014 by a man named Maurice Skyler whom he has spoken with, and says it is worth hearing again.
mentions.quote: His name is Maurice Skyler
mentions.falsify_match: Not his claim; another person's dream that he endorses and reads.

mentions.claim_text: He says social media, the internet and YouTube pull attention away from the word and from going vertical, so people lose sight of themselves.
mentions.quote: There's so many things that pull our attention from this beautiful word
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching.

mentions.claim_text: Reading the dream, he describes stock being moved from one store to another and armed guards with semi-automatic weapons at most grocery stores and Walmarts, military men rather than police, as a police state protecting supply.
mentions.quote: I saw military men at most grocery stores and Walmart stores
mentions.falsify_match: Military guards deployed at American grocery stores.

mentions.claim_text: He says the dream was given in 2024 and is starting to manifest now in April 2025, that it is a serious time, and that he knows for a fact the man hears the voice of the Lord because he has seen many of his words.
mentions.quote: here we are in 2025 and it's starting to manifest
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as stated: starting to manifest is asserted without a marker.

mentions.claim_text: He says he tells them this to prepare rather than scare, that he has yelled as loud as he can, and that he does not know how much longer the Lord will keep him on YouTube because he may be told he is done.
mentions.quote: I don't know how much longer the Lord will have me always on YouTube
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: framing, though it pairs with events-without-warning.
